instrumentRows.label: Mellow Keys
requiredPerception: immediate but click-free onset
soft triangle-led body
audible but restrained upper partials
short musical decay
rejectIf: label implies an acoustic piano sample

instrumentRows.label: FM Electric Piano
requiredPerception: tine-like bright onset
brightness responds audibly to velocity
decay settles toward a softer sine body
click-free release
rejectIf: label claims a sampled brand instrument

instrumentRows.label: Vibraphone
requiredPerception: clear mallet-like onset
mostly sine-like sustained body
slow audible tremolo after its delay
long clean release
rejectIf: transient dominates as a separate pitch

instrumentRows.label: Warm Pad
requiredPerception: slow click-free bloom
mild detune width without beating nausea
dark filtered sustain
long smooth release

instrumentRows.label: Analog Poly
requiredPerception: distinct saw and pulse color
audible quiet sub foundation
resonant filter motion without whistle
compact synth release

instrumentRows.label: Concert Grand
requiredPerception: percussive hammer-like onset without a click
inharmonic piano-like partials with audible unison shimmer
fast early decay settling into a longer singing tail
damper-style release that ends cleanly
rejectIf: sounds like a static organ-like sustain
label claims a sampled or recorded acoustic piano

instrumentRows.label: Flute
requiredPerception: breathy tongued onset that blooms into the tone
fundamental-dominant body that brightens as it is blown harder
audible air in the sustain and a vibrato that arrives after the onset
pitch holds within a few cents across the register
rejectIf: static organ-like sine stack with no breath
vibrato present from the first millisecond
locks an octave high or fails to speak in the written register
label claims a recorded or sampled flute

instrumentRows.label: Organ
requiredPerception: fast click-free organ-like attack
steady sustained drawbar-like sine body
shallow continuous vibrato
release ends cleanly without a click
rejectIf: vibrato surges in depth or sounds like a trill
a percussive transient dominates the attack
label claims a sampled or electromechanical organ

instrumentRows.label: Guitar
requiredPerception: plucked attack with pick definition and no click
two-stage decay with slow polarization beating on held notes
woody archtop body color and a dark clean-amp top end
wound-string shimmer in the low register
rejectIf: sawtooth-like buzz or a static sustain
energy grows after the pluck (an unstable loop)
label claims a recorded or sampled guitar or a commercial amp

instrumentRows.label: Upright Bass
requiredPerception: plucked woody pizzicato attack without a click
deep fundamental-forward body true to a double bass
natural fast decay into a short damped release
recorded timbre stays on pitch across the playing range
rejectIf: synthetic buzz or a static organ-like sustain
chipmunk or smeared artifact on transposed keys
label claims synthesis it does not perform or a commercial brand

instrumentRows.label: Concert Vibes
requiredPerception: soft mallet onset without a click
bell-like ringing body with the bar's double-octave shimmer
long metallic sustain that decays smoothly into the release
recorded timbre stays on pitch across the playing range
rejectIf: an added synthesized tremolo (the recording has none)
label claims synthesis it does not perform or a commercial brand

instrumentRows.label: Blues Guitar
requiredPerception: the same plucked string heard through a hotter amp: compression and drive grit
presence-peak bite absent from the clean profile
cab-voiced band-limited body, no fizz above the rolloff
single notes sustain with harmonic thickening, not fuzz collapse
rejectIf: identical timbre to the clean Guitar profile
fizzy aliasing or a gated buzz
label claims a recorded or sampled guitar or a commercial amp

scenarioRows.pass: chord remains intelligible with no obvious clipping, severe pumping, or painful resonance
no click, old attack, stuck note, doubled voice, or missing first replay attack
already sounding release stays smooth and no X0 voice artifact appears
release precedes attack without click, flam, or swallowed onset
tail decays smoothly and is fully gone by the declared voice deadline
no stale sound on interruption; gesture recovery does not replay retired voices
same recipe and effects are perceptually identical for the same chord and settings
both use the same effects; releasing preview does not interrupt progression
old voices release in their original timbre; new attacks use the selected recipe; no graph dropout
